members.name: Action Converter
members.description: 5 concrete real-life actions for today, leverage-scored against open loops with specificity and anti-fluff gates

members.name: cost-report
members.description: Weekly API cost report — computes dollar costs from token usage, flags anomalies, forecasts burn, and prescribes concrete optimizations

members.name: Evening Recap
members.description: End-of-day operational summary — what Aeon shipped, what failed, what needs follow-up

members.name: fork-skill-digest
members.description: Weekly cross-fork customization digest — surfaces where the fleet's enable/disable/var/model decisions diverge from upstream defaults

members.name: Goal Tracker
members.description: Compare current progress against goals with quantified status, velocity, trend, and a concrete next action per goal

members.name: Heartbeat
members.description: Proactive ambient check — surface anything worth attention

members.name: Janitor
members.description: Weekly cleanup of accumulated temp files — .notify-* root-level files, .pending-notify-temp/, and stale .outputs/ chain artifacts older than their TTL

members.name: Memory Flush
members.description: Promote important recent log entries into MEMORY.md

members.name: Morning Brief
members.description: Priority-driven daily briefing — the 3 things to focus on today, why now, and what moved

members.name: Note Taking
members.description: Save a note as a Supernotes card (if configured) or to a local memory/notes/ file

members.name: onboard
members.description: One-shot setup validator — runs every check from the ./onboard CLI inside the workflow and sends the resulting checklist to the configured notification channel

members.name: operator-scorecard
members.description: Weekly plain-language synthesis of agent health + community growth + economic activity — answers "was this week worth it?" in one notification

members.name: Planner
members.description: Decide the day's work — read goals, fleet health, and recent activity, then produce a ranked plan and (opt-in) dispatch the skills that matter most today

members.name: Weekly Reflect
members.description: Review recent activity, consolidate memory, and prune stale entries

members.name: run-frequency-guard
members.description: Daily per-skill run-count watchdog — checks if any capped skills exceeded their configured daily limit and alerts on breach

members.name: Search Skills
members.description: Search the open agent skills ecosystem for skills that fill a real gap and install them via the native add-skill path

members.name: self-improve
members.description: Improve the agent itself — better skills, prompts, workflows, and config based on recent performance

members.name: Self Review
members.description: Weekly audit of what the agent did, what failed, and what to improve

members.name: skill-analytics
members.description: Weekly fleet-level skill-run analytics — ranks skills by 7d run count, surfaces success rates, exit-taxonomy distribution, and anomaly flags (significance-gated)

members.name: Skill Evals
members.description: Validate skill outputs against assertions, diff vs prior eval to flag regressions, file issues for new failures, and queue concrete fixes

members.name: Skill Health
members.description: Audit skill metrics, file/resolve issues in memory/issues/, and notify on state change only

members.name: skill-leaderboard
members.description: Weekly ranking of which skills are most popular across CONFIGURED Aeon forks (excludes untouched templates)

members.description: Auto-generate Smithery + MCP Registry submission docs from skills.json and the aeon-mcp server — turns the 6-week-stuck "submit Aeon to Smithery" idea into a copy-paste form

members.name: v4-readiness
members.description: Generate a per-fork v4 upgrade readiness checklist — reads the fork's aeon.yml, skills.json, and MEMORY.md, cross-references against the embedded v4 change manifest, emits Safe / Review / Custom / Action-items breakdown

members.name: Weekly Review
members.description: KALM retrospective grounded in objective metrics, with closed-loop tracking of last week's actions and SMART next-week actions
